product_results.title: Seresto Flea & Tick Collar For Dogs Over 18 lbs., Treatment & Prevention, Vet-Recommend, 8 Month Protection
product_results.description: Give your dog long-lasting protection against fleas and ticks with the number-one vet-recommended flea and tick collar*. Unlike other flea and tick protection, Seresto large dog collars kill and repel fleas and ticks for 8 continuous months. Seresto collars make your dog’s comfort a priority by killing fleas and ticks through contact, so pests don't have to bite your dog to die. Existing fleas die after 24 hours of initial application of the collar. After 24 hours, any new fleas on the dog are killed within 2 hours with protection against further flea infestation lasting 8 months. The prevention of infestations with new ticks starts at 48 hours after application of the collar. 48 hours after application, any new ticks are repelled and/or killed in as quickly as 6 hours. Seresto large dog collars protect against common pests like deer ticks, American dog ticks, brown dog ticks, and Lone Star ticks; they're also effective against chewing lice for 8 months. Fleas and ticks not only cause discomfort; fleas can transmit bartonellosis or tapeworms. Ticks can transmit Borrelia burgdorferi, which causes Lyme Disease. Check the product label for information on potential side effects. Seresto large dog flea and tick collars are for dogs at least 7 weeks old and over 18 pounds, and no prescription is needed. They're odorless, non-greasy and water-resistant to swimming, exposure to rain or sunlight, bathing, and shampoo treatment.* Seresto is a trademark of Elanco or its affiliates. * Seresto large dog is water resistant and remains effective following a shampoo treatment, swimming or after exposure to rain or sunlight. Under normal conditions, effectiveness lasts for 8 months. In order to maintain an 8-month duration, dogs must not be bathed more than once per month. For dogs that swim once a month or more, the control duration is reduced to 5 months for flea control and reduced to 7 months for tick control.

authors_reviews.title: LONG THOROUGH REVIEW from a skeptical pessimist
authors_reviews.text: This collar is PERFECT. Okay so I was really really super skeptical about buying this for several reasons:- I hate the thought of my two pups having to constantly wear an extra collar- I've tried the flea/tick collars from Walmart and they were greasy and had a weird smell but even worse, they did NOT work.- I've read some of the horrifying reviews- I'm just a skeptical person and simply didn't think this would work.BUT IM A BELIEVER NOW.For context, I have a 3yr old short haired ~45lbs pup (pitbull, lab, corgi mix) and and a 7yr old long haired ~30-35lbs pup (Lhasa Apso terrier mix). I live in Maryland where the weather is just always unpredictable. I feel like we have like 6 seasons instead of 4. We have woods in the back of our house which deer always like to frequent, along with a swamp/pond across the street. This spring and the start of this summer we had a monsoon season where afterwards, there was an annoying infestation of ticks (mostly Lone Star and Deer ticks). It was disgusting. I legitimately could not take my dogs out for a walk without finding at least 4 ticks on them afterwards and on me!!! And this is on top of treating my dogs with the monthly tick/flea topical oil treatment. That's how bad it was, which is what prompted me to buy the Seresto collars. (I bought Large for both of them)Once I did and placed them on my dogs, after maybe like 1-2 days, I have not found a single tick on them. I know that sounds so far fetched but I don't know what else to say because it's absolutely true. It does take about 1-2 days for the medication to get into the system (from experience and from *I think* what the package said) because I still did find a few ticks on them the next day. But after that, not a single tick! They've been wearing the collars for about 1.5 months now so I'm still keeping an eye on them (I plan on updating this review after 7-8 months to see if the claim of lasting 8 months is legitimate). Right now though, I am sooo happy.Now I want to address some of the other reviews I saw. After I saw some of the pictures of rashes this collar left on some dogs, I was worried, especially cause my smaller one already has exist in skin issues. But both are doing perfectly well with no skin issues from the collar. I don't want to be presumptuous and I may be totally wrong, but I'm thinking maybe the rashes the other dogs had were because they're not used to wearing collars? So they just kept itching at it? Maybe? I say that because for me at least, my dogs are used to wearing their regular collars nearly 24/7 since they were babies. So when I added the Seresto collars, they were unphased. But then again I'm also aware that just like humans, each dog reacts differently. Luckily, My dogs have no rash problems from the collars.As for some claiming that the collar doesn't work.. I'm not sure what to say other than that they really truly work for my dogs, and I live in a heavily tick infested area. It really is like night and day in terms of how well this collar works at preventing tick bites. Especially with my long haired dog since ticks would easily hide in her fur.The collar isn't greasy nor does it have a strong emanating odor. BUT it's still medicated so it still has a very slight residue to it but nothing that interferes with everyday life.I'm sold and plan on continuing with this product from here on out. NO MORE GREASY NASTY SMELLY TOPICAL MONTHLY TICK GREASE!**Side note**Make sure you read the packaging instructions carefully!! They mention a few things like about how the efficacy is shortened to something like 5 months for dogs who swim a lot, or how the collar is designed to unlatch if the dog pulls incase it gets stuck on something (which I thoroughly appreciate) so you CANNOT substitute this as a walking collar! The collar DOES unlatch if you hold onto it and your dog pulls (personal experience: guests came over, one jumps and I accidentally grabbed the Seresto collar and it unlatched). But you CAN reattach it!! So definitely take the time to read the package instructions.Hope this helps! I really loveeeee this collar. THANK YOU SERESTO!!!

authors_reviews.title: Avoided...now 100% loyal customer!
authors_reviews.text: I have a pit-lab mix pup, 10 months old. When he was about 5-6 months old, he started itching constantly, and literally chewing himself raw in places. Longer story short, I was using a drop on for fleas that didn't work. I live in Central FL and have fleas year round. He brought fleas into the house, and they literally EXPLODED everywhere! My 6 indoor cats got infested, the carpets, everything. If this wasn't bad enough, my pup developed a horrific allergy to fleas and their bites. He was miserable...constantly itching and chewing! Bald patches, and scabs everywhere.I sprayed the house, and also used an IGR. (Insect growth regulator) Flea combed everyone, everyday, several times. Drop-on for everyone, though I didn't know at the time it wasn't working. Capstar for everyone every 2-3 days. Baths for the pup every few days with medicated shampoos and flea shampoos. I became very frustrated because the drop-op wasn't doing anything. It was a nightmare!!I looked at this flea collar along with others, but was afraid to try anything because of the horrible side effects some dogs had. My guy was already sooo miserable, that I didn't want to take a chance on causing him more pain, etc.After weeks of this, and my pup being severely allergic to fleas, and having lost so much fur from chewing and scratching that he looked like he had mange or something on several areas of his body, I finally broke down and ordered a collar to try. I was very skeptical and doubted it could help, and definitely didn't want to waste $60 in these tough financial times.WELL!! First of all, he had no bad reaction to it, thank goodnes!! And within a week of wearing it, he stopped 95% of the chewing and scratching. I was utterly amazed to say the least.It's now a month later, and he's 99.99% scratch free, and all his hair has regrown!! He's once again shiny and silky black, and a very happy pup!!!While I'm extatic that the collar worked soooo well, I admit that I remain concerned about the chemicals that are going thru his body via the collar. However, anything that you use for fleas and ticks is going to introduce chemicals. While I fear cancer, having lost a loved dog to it last year, there's no way that I want this pup to suffer like he was suffering before using this collar!! I want him to have a happy, comfortable life. He runs and plays on almost 2 acres, with year round fleas, ticks, and mosquitoes. He'll be wearing this flea collar the rest of his life!!!I've read many many of the reviews. And because some people have said that the caller stops working earlier than 8 months, I'll simply buy one and have it on hand in case this one stops working early. Even if it only works for 6 months, that's only $10 a month for complete comfort for my pup. Totally worth it!!!Update 6/24/26:I continue using this for my pup. He'll be 3 soon. It continues to work well. However, in my situation, it must be changed appropriately every 6 months. I know when it's time because my guy starts itching again. I always make a notation on a sticky note of when I changed the collar, and I stick it on the empty can and put it in the closet. That way, when he starts itching again, I have a reference to how long he's had the collar on. I also spray the house every 6 months with an IGR. That way I'm positive that my 5 indoor cats will not get any stray fleas he might bring in before they're dead. EXCELLENT PRODUCT!! Well worth the cost!!

authors_reviews.title: this thing is the real deal.
authors_reviews.text: Not a paid review, just an honest buyer. I live in TN where it’s really hot and muggy in the summer, hence heavy tick season. My corgi loves playing in my backyard, and I also have a small wooded area attached to it which obviously attracts these ticks (He never goes in there, but it’s there)Anyway, we tried topical treatments, oral meds, flea shampoo, but nothing worked. He was constantly scratching and itching, and I even got flea bites all over me. One day I was browsing on Amazon looking for the top rated solution to fix this issue and came across the Seresto collar. I checked with my vet and they were selling it at double the price, so I figured why not just buy it on Amazon since it's way cheaper and try it for myself.Within 2 days of putting it on, my corgi stopped scratching and itching, and I stopped getting flea bites. (He sleeps with me on the bed. I also sprayed the house and treated the yard in addition to using this collar.) He did not have any allergic reaction to it and was perfectly okay with having it on constantly. This thing worked fast, better yet, it actually worked. Like, it’s the real deal. Highly recommend.
